title: Set Up Your Booking Reminders
lede: Confirm the booking, keep them engaged and remind them to show up.
deliverable: A simple email and SMS reminder flow, plus a call task for an unconfirmed appointment.
body:
Someone books a call. They should get the details straight away, know how to confirm, and get reminded before the meeting. That is what this automation does.

Calendly handles the booking and calendar invitation. Your connected email and SMS tools send the messages. Jarvis helps you write and set up the flow.

The reminder flow

WhenWhat happens
As soon as they bookConfirmation email and SMS with the time, confirmation-page link and how to confirm attendance. They also receive the calendar invitation.
48 hours beforeEmail reminder. Include something useful about the problem you will help them solve.
24 hours beforeEmail and SMS reminder.
2 hours beforeEmail with the meeting details.
1 hour before, if they have not confirmedYou get a notification to call them. This is a task for you, not another automated SMS.
5 minutes beforeShort email and SMS with the meeting link.

If they book closer to the meeting, skip reminders whose time has already passed. Don’t send the whole sequence at once. If they cancel or move the call, stop the old reminders and use the new booking time.

The confirmation call

If the appointment is still unconfirmed one hour before, call and say:

Hey [name], it’s [your name]. I was just going through my calendar and noticed your appointment hasn’t been confirmed yet. Are you still all good to show up for [time]?

If they say yes, confirm the time and tell them where the meeting link is. Record that they confirmed. If the time no longer works, help them reschedule.

Give Jarvis the job

Run the pre-call follow up skill for my saved offer and funnel using this reminder schedule. Calendar: [your Calendly link].

Put one test booking through it. Check the email, SMS, calendar invitation and the one-hour call task before switching it on.
